lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ag8Sb4Sn4S16 (reduced formula Ag2SbSnS4) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Pnma (No. 38), with 32 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Ag centers as octahedral with six S neighbors, while Sb and Sn each adopt tetrahedral S coordination. The Ag octahedra share edges with one another and corners with Sb and Sn tetrahedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
